name: Sanʼyō-Onoda (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sanʼyō-Onoda city emblem in white: a stylised globe of curved strokes above an arc.
history: Municipal flag of Sanʼyō-Onoda, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 February 2006.

features.role: Sanʼyō-Onoda city emblem — a stylised globe of curved strokes above an arc
